globals.label: box
globals.detail: (w, h, d) | ([x, y, z]) | ({ x, y, z, center })
globals.info: Box centred on the origin; one size makes a cube; the size may also be [x, y, z] or { x, y, z }.

globals.label: cube
globals.info: Alias of box().

globals.label: roundedBox
globals.detail: (w, h, d, r, { edges }) | ([x, y, z], r, { edges })
globals.info: Box with rounded edges; edges: 'all' or 'vertical' (only the four vertical edges, prints flat). The size may also be [x, y, z] or { x, y, z, r }.

globals.label: sphere
globals.info: Sphere centred on the origin.

globals.label: cylinder
globals.info: Cylinder along Y, centred; r1/r2 give a tapered cylinder.

globals.label: cone
globals.info: Cone along Y with its base radius r.

globals.label: torus
globals.info: Torus in the XZ plane: ring radius r, tube radius tube.

globals.label: prism
globals.info: Regular n-sided prism with circumradius r and height h.

globals.label: polygon
globals.info: Extrude a 2D point list up along Y by h.

globals.label: polyhedron
globals.info: Solid from raw vertices and faces, like OpenSCAD; winding is fixed automatically.

globals.label: loft
globals.info: Skin between 2D profiles stacked along Y.

globals.label: text3d
globals.info: Raised or engraved text as a solid, baseline at y = 0.

globals.label: circle
globals.info: 2D circle.

globals.label: ellipse
globals.info: 2D ellipse.

globals.label: rect
globals.info: 2D rectangle, centred by default.

globals.label: square
globals.info: Alias of rect().

globals.label: roundedRect
globals.info: 2D rectangle with rounded corners.

globals.label: slot
globals.info: Capsule: two semicircles length apart (centre to centre).

globals.label: teardrop
globals.info: Circle with a 45° point at +y: a horizontal hole that prints without sagging.

globals.label: bridgedCircle
globals.info: Circle with a flat ceiling for the slicer to bridge.

globals.label: regularPolygon
globals.info: Regular polygon with circumradius r.

globals.label: polygon2d
globals.info: Arbitrary 2D polygon from [[x, y], ...]; pass { holes: [[...]] } for holes.

globals.label: text
globals.info: 2D text outline, baseline at y = 0. Fonts: 'Inter', 'Inter Bold', 'Nunito Bold', 'Source Serif 4', 'JetBrains Mono'.

globals.label: sketch
globals.info: Draw a profile step by step: moveTo, lineTo, line, horizontal, vertical, quadTo, bezierTo, arcTo, tangentArcTo, fillet, close.

globals.label: extrude
globals.info: Extrude a sketch up along Y; twist in degrees, scale at the top.

globals.label: revolve
globals.info: Revolve a sketch around Y; sketch x is the radius.

globals.label: roof
globals.info: Solid whose height is the distance to the outline: pyramid from a square, hip roof from a rectangle.

globals.label: projection
globals.info: Flatten a solid to a 2D sketch: footprint from above, or the slice at height y.

globals.label: path
globals.info: Polyline through 3D points (Y up); [x, y] points lie on the ground plane.

globals.label: line
globals.info: Straight path from a to b.

globals.label: arc
globals.info: Arc on the ground plane centred on the origin, from +X anticlockwise seen from above.

globals.label: helix
globals.info: Helix around Y starting at [r, 0, 0].

globals.label: bezier
globals.info: Cubic Bézier curve as a path.

globals.label: sweep
globals.detail: (sketch | (t) => sketch, path, { frame, up, twist, scale, segments })
globals.info: Sweep a 2D profile along a path; closed paths make rings. frame: 'minimal' (no twist) or 'upright'.

globals.label: svg
globals.info: An SVG drawing as a Sketch: filled paths, rects, circles, polygons, in mm with Y up. import logo from './logo.svg' does the same for a project file.

globals.label: svgPath
globals.info: SVG path data as a Sketch in its own units, Y flipped.

globals.label: heightmap
globals.detail: (image | (x, z) => 0..1, { width, depth, height, base, invert, smooth, gamma, resolution })
globals.info: Relief solid: brightness (or a function of position) becomes height above a base plate.

globals.label: lithophane
globals.detail: (image, { width, depth, minThickness, maxThickness, border, smooth, gamma, resolution, upright })
globals.info: Plate whose thickness follows the image: dark is thick, light is thin. Light it from behind.

globals.label: distance
globals.info: Distance between faces (along the normal), a face and a point, or two points.

globals.label: rectPattern
globals.info: The four corners of a w × d rectangle as [u, v] points, for hole patterns.

globals.label: gridPattern
globals.info: A grid of [u, v] points at that pitch, centred.

globals.label: printer
globals.info: Declare the printer once; hole(), wall(), layers(), fit() and peg() use it.

globals.label: wall
globals.info: Wall thickness rounded up to whole extrusion lines.

globals.label: layers
globals.info: Height rounded up to whole layers.

globals.label: fit
globals.info: Hole diameter to model so a d mm part fits.

globals.label: peg
globals.info: Peg diameter to model so it fits a d mm hole.

globals.label: dimension
globals.info: A measured line between points, faces or shapes, drawn on rendered views; returns the length.

globals.label: mark
globals.info: A labelled dot drawn on rendered views.

globals.label: clearance
globals.info: Smallest gap between two shapes in mm; 0 when they touch or overlap.

globals.label: interference
globals.info: Volume two shapes share in mm³.

globals.label: intersects
globals.info: True when two shapes share any volume.

globals.label: overlap
globals.info: The volume two shapes share, as a Shape.

globals.label: printability
globals.info: Printing verdict: { ok, problems, overhangs, unsupported, minWall }.

globals.label: overhangs
globals.info: Area of undersides steeper than angle (45°) from vertical.

globals.label: unsupported
globals.info: Overhangs with nothing below them: islands and bridges.

globals.label: minWallThickness
globals.info: The thinnest wall: { thickness, at }.

globals.label: fillet
globals.info: Round the sharp edges of a solid (or the corners of a sketch).

globals.label: chamfer
globals.info: Bevel the sharp edges of a solid (or cut the corners of a sketch).

globals.label: sharpEdges
globals.info: List the sharp edges of a solid: { p0, p1, t, nA, nB, convex, angle, length }.

globals.label: union
globals.info: Merge shapes (or 2D sketches). Arrays are accepted.

globals.label: difference
globals.info: Subtract every following shape from the first.

globals.label: intersect
globals.info: Keep only the common volume.

globals.label: hull
globals.info: Convex hull of shapes, sketches or raw points.

globals.label: minkowski
globals.info: Minkowski sum: sweep b over every point of a.

globals.label: shell
globals.info: Hollow a solid to wall thickness t, optionally removing faces.

globals.label: resize
globals.info: Scale to a bounding-box size; 0 keeps an axis, auto scales it proportionally.

globals.label: linearArray
globals.info: count copies stepped by a vector (returns an array; wrap in union()).

globals.label: polarArray
globals.info: count copies around an axis (returns an array).

globals.label: grid
globals.info: nx × nz grid on the ground plane (returns an array).

globals.label: gear
globals.detail: ({ module, teeth, pressureAngle, thickness, helix, backlash, bore })
globals.info: Involute spur or helical gear: axis Y, base on y = 0, tooth 0 along +X.

globals.label: gear2d
globals.info: The outline of an involute gear as a 2D sketch.

globals.label: gearPair
globals.info: Two meshing gears: [first, second], the second along +X at the right distance and turned to mesh.

globals.label: gearDistance
globals.info: Centre distance of two meshing gears: module × (teeth1 + teeth2) / 2.

globals.label: rack
globals.detail: ({ module, teeth, pressureAngle, thickness, height, backlash })
globals.info: Straight gear rack: pitch line along X at z = 0, teeth toward -Z.

globals.label: ringGear
globals.detail: ({ module, teeth, thickness, rim, backlash, helix })
globals.info: Internal (ring) gear: teeth inside a rim, centred on the origin, axis Y.

globals.label: ringAddendum
globals.info: The ring tooth height in modules (at most 1) that keeps a small pinion clear of the ring's tips.

globals.label: planetary
globals.snippet: planetary({ module: ${1}, sun: ${12}, planet: ${12}, planets: ${3}, backlash: ${0.2} })
globals.detail: ({ module, sun, planet, planets, thickness, backlash, helix, rim, sunBore, planetBore })
globals.info: A planetary set { sun, planets, ring }, assembled and phased; ring teeth = sun + 2 x planet.

globals.label: thread
globals.detail: ({ size: 'M8' | 'M8x1' | 'Tr8x8(P2)', length, internal, pitch, profile, starts, left, tolerance, chamfer })
globals.info: Screw thread along Y from y = 0: a threaded rod, or with internal: true the cutter for a threaded hole.

globals.label: split
globals.detail: (shape, { x | y | z: at | [at, ...] }, { dowels, dowelDiameter, dowelLength, tolerance, wall, layout, gap })
globals.info: Cut a shape into pieces across one axis, optionally with dowel holes and laid out cut-face-down for printing.

globals.label: hole
globals.detail: (r, length, { axis: 'x' | 'y' | 'z', shape: 'teardrop' | 'bridge' | 'round', angle, flat, tolerance })
globals.info: Printable hole cutter centred on the origin; horizontal holes get a teardrop top by default.

globals.label: screwHole
globals.info: Cutter for a screw hole: axis Y, top surface at y = 0. Sizes M2 M2.5 M3 M4 M5 M6 M8.

globals.label: nutPocket
globals.info: Hexagonal nut pocket cutter: axis Y, top at y = 0.

globals.label: heatInsert
globals.info: Heat-set insert hole cutter: axis Y, top at y = 0.

globals.label: screw
globals.info: Screw dimensions: { d, clearance, head, csk, nut, insert, tap }.

globals.label: SCREWS
globals.info: Table of metric screw dimensions by size.

globals.label: show
globals.info: Display a shape without returning it.

globals.label: log
globals.info: Print to the console.

globals.label: echo
globals.info: OpenSCAD-style console output with the line number; returns the first value.

globals.label: assert
globals.info: Stop the build with an error on this line when the condition is falsy.

globals.label: deg
globals.info: Radians to degrees.

globals.label: rad
globals.info: Degrees to radians.

methods.label: translate
methods.info: Move; sketches take (x, y).

methods.label: rotate
methods.info: Rotate in degrees; sketches take one angle.

methods.label: scale
methods.info: Scale uniformly or per axis.

methods.label: mirror
methods.info: Mirror across an axis plane.

methods.label: resize
methods.info: Scale to a bounding-box size; 0 keeps an axis.

methods.label: color
methods.info: Display colour: #hex, a CSS name, rgb() or hsl().

methods.label: onPlate
methods.info: Put the bottom on the build plate.

methods.label: center
methods.info: Centre on the origin.

methods.label: centerXZ
methods.info: Centre in X and Z, keeping Y.

methods.label: align
methods.info: Align the bounding box to a point.

methods.label: add
methods.info: Union.

methods.label: union
methods.info: Union.

methods.label: subtract
methods.info: Difference.

methods.label: intersect
methods.info: Intersection.

methods.label: hull
methods.info: Convex hull with other shapes.

methods.label: minkowski
methods.info: Minkowski sum.

methods.label: round
methods.info: Round all edges and corners (grows by r).

methods.label: erode
methods.info: Shrink inward by t on every face.

methods.label: shell
methods.info: Hollow to a wall thickness.

methods.label: projection
methods.info: Footprint or cut slice as a 2D sketch.

methods.label: name
methods.info: Name the part (Parts panel, export file names).

methods.label: ghost
methods.info: Render transparent as a reference; never exported.

methods.label: hide
methods.info: List in the Parts panel but do not draw.

methods.label: bounds
methods.info: { min, max, size, center }.

methods.label: volume
methods.info: Volume in mm³.

methods.label: clearance
methods.info: Smallest gap to another shape in mm; 0 when they touch or overlap.

methods.label: interference
methods.info: Volume shared with another shape in mm³.

methods.label: intersects
methods.info: True when the shapes share any volume.

methods.label: overlap
methods.info: The volume shared with another shape, as a Shape.

methods.label: anchor
methods.info: Record a named point that moves with the shape, or get it back as { point, normal }.

methods.label: emboss
methods.detail: (sketch | 'text', face | anchor, { depth, at, angle, size, font, center })
methods.info: Raise a sketch or text out of a face, oriented to read from outside.

methods.label: engrave
methods.detail: (sketch | 'text', face | anchor, { depth, at, angle, size, font, center })
methods.info: Cut a sketch or text into a face.

methods.label: face
methods.info: A face of the bounding box: { center, normal, min, max, size }.

methods.label: at
methods.info: Put the shape's origin on a face with +Y along its normal (cutters and bosses land on it).

methods.label: placeOn
methods.info: Put the shape on a face of another, touching and centred.

methods.label: alignTo
methods.info: Align bounding boxes per axis: 'min' | 'center' | 'max', or 'left'/'right', 'below'/'above', 'back'/'front'.

methods.label: printability
methods.info: Printing verdict: { ok, problems, ... }.

methods.label: overhangs
methods.info: Undersides steeper than 45°: { area, worstAngle }.

methods.label: unsupported
methods.info: Islands and bridges: overhangs with nothing below.

methods.label: minWallThickness
methods.info: The thinnest wall: { thickness, at }.

methods.label: surfaceArea
methods.info: Surface area in mm².

methods.label: isEmpty
methods.info: True if the shape has no volume / area.

methods.label: area
methods.info: Area of a sketch in mm².

methods.label: offset
methods.info: Grow (+) or shrink (−) a 2D region.

methods.label: fillet
methods.info: Round every corner of a sketch, or the sharp edges of a solid; edges: 'all' | 'top' | 'bottom' | 'horizontal' | 'vertical' | 'convex' | 'concave'.

methods.label: chamfer
methods.info: Cut every corner of a sketch, or bevel the sharp edges of a solid; edges as for fillet.

methods.label: extrude
methods.info: Extrude a sketch up along Y.

methods.label: revolve
methods.info: Revolve a sketch around Y.

methods.label: roof
methods.info: Roof solid from a sketch.

methods.label: toPolygons
methods.info: Outline rings of a sketch as [[x, y], ...][].

methods.label: sweep
methods.info: Sweep a sketch along a path.

methods.label: blur
methods.info: Soften an image by a radius in pixels.

methods.label: crop
methods.info: Cut a rectangle out of an image (pixels).

methods.label: gamma
methods.info: Lighten (< 1) or darken (> 1) the mid-tones of an image.

methods.label: invert
methods.info: Swap light and dark in an image.

methods.label: normalize
methods.info: Stretch an image to the full 0..1 range.

methods.label: flip
methods.info: Mirror an image.

methods.label: moveTo
methods.info: Start the outline here.

methods.label: lineTo
methods.info: Segment to a point.

methods.label: line
methods.info: Relative segment.

methods.label: horizontal
methods.info: Horizontal relative segment.

methods.label: vertical
methods.info: Vertical relative segment.

methods.label: arcTo
methods.info: Circular arc of radius r to a point.

methods.label: tangentArcTo
methods.info: Arc tangent to the previous segment, ending at a point.

methods.label: quadTo
methods.info: Quadratic Bézier curve to a point, pulled toward one control point.

methods.label: bezierTo
methods.detail: (c1x, c1y, c2x, c2y, x, y, { segments })
methods.info: Cubic Bézier curve to a point with two control points.

methods.label: close
methods.info: Finish the outline as a Sketch; mirror appends the mirror image.

methods.label: append
methods.info: Continue with another path, moved to start where this one ends.

methods.label: close
methods.info: Join the ends of a path so the sweep is a ring.

methods.label: smooth
methods.info: Replace the corners of a path with a smooth curve.

methods.label: reverse
methods.info: Travel a path the other way.

methods.label: length
methods.info: Length of a path in mm.

methods.label: pointAt
methods.info: Point at fraction t (0..1) of a path.

methods.label: tangentAt
methods.info: Unit direction at fraction t (0..1) of a path.
